title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

providers.name: AWS
providers.scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: Permission set session duration
controls.what: Sets how long Identity Center role credentials last (1-12 h, default 1 h).
controls.setting: IAM Identity Center > Permission sets > Session duration

controls.name: Deny policy for Identity Center user (SCP with user ID)
controls.what: Pre-staged SCP deny that, once the user ID is added, blocks all actions from the user's active role sessions.

controls.name: Disable user access (IAM Identity Center)
controls.what: Disabling or deleting an Identity Center user blocks new portal sign-in and new IAM role sessions.

auth_paths.name: IAM Identity Center credentials for AWS CLI/SDK

authentication.summary: User signs in to the AWS access portal (device code flow via aws configure sso); the CLI calls GetRoleCredentials to get short-term STS credentials for a permission set role, refreshing them while the portal session is active.

federation.details: Credentials come from the Identity Center session, which follows the configured identity source. Disabling the user blocks new sessions, but existing IAM role sessions continue until their permission-set duration ends (max 12 h).

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. It is evaluated on every signed API request. aws:SourceIp is absent for calls through VPC endpoints (use aws:VpcSourceIp) and SCPs do not cover the management account.

lifetime.summary: Role creds 1-12 h (default 1 h); portal session up to 90 days

renewal.summary: CLI refreshes role credentials automatically while the portal session lasts.

administration.summary: Admins set permission-set session duration and assignments. To cut live access, pre-stage an SCP deny keyed to the Identity Center user ID, then remove assignments.
administration.conditions: IAM revoke-sessions cannot be used on roles created from permission sets.

sso.details: CLI/SDK role credentials are obtained from the user's Identity Center sign-in session, which uses the org's identity source.

offboard.details: Deleting or disabling the user blocks new sessions immediately, but existing IAM role sessions continue for up to 12 hours.

sso.ui: IAM Identity Center console > Settings > Authentication tab > Multi-factor authentication > Configure (external IdP: set MFA in the IdP)

network.ui: AWS Organizations console > Policies > Service control policies > Create policy (Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp) > attach to OU/account (roles created by permission sets cannot be edited in IAM)

reads.ui: CloudTrail console > Trails > trail > Data events > Edit > enable S3 data events; then filter trail logs on eventName=GetObject (not in Event history)

kill.ui: Add user ID to the pre-staged SCP Deny; IAM Identity Center > AWS accounts > account > Assigned users and groups > Remove access; Users > user > Disable user access; keep the deny for 12 h

offboard.ui: IAM Identity Center console > Users > user > General information > Disable user access (or delete user)

token_format.notes: Role credentials are standard STS temporary credentials.

log_sources.name: AWS CloudTrail event history
log_sources.notes: On by default; 90 days of management events per Region; free. Data events (e.g. S3 GetObject) not included.

log_sources.name: CloudTrail trail / event data store
log_sources.notes: Needed for retention beyond 90 days; data events off by default and cost extra.

credential_id_fields.notes: Identity Center user ID for user-initiated events.

lifecycle_events.notes: Portal API call that returns STS credentials (logging not verified on fetched pages).

anomaly_cues: Role sessions after user is disabled

containment.steps: Add user ID to pre-staged SCP deny, remove assignments, disable user.
containment.notes: Disabling the user alone leaves existing role sessions working up to 12 h.

unknown: Exact CloudTrail eventName for portal GetRoleCredentials.
